items.name: Illinois Speedcubing - Mini Sunday 2022

venue.name: Mt. Prospect Public Library
venue.address: 10 S. Emerson St, Mount Prospect, IL 60056, USA

items.information:
This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ILSTourneyMiniSunday2022#20302-competitor-responsibilities) tab. Please also be sure to review the [Health and Safety](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ILSTourneyMiniSunday2022#20303-health-safety) tab to check additional COVID-19 requirements for this competition.

Join our [Facebook group](https://www.facebook.com/groups/2382471798653473/) to get notified when future competitions in the area get announced and to socialize with other speedcubers!

items.name: Thoothukudi Cube Open 2022

venue.name: Subbiah Vidyalayam Girls Higher Secondary school
venue.address: 120/2, Perumalpuram Rd, Pudugramam, Thoothukudi, Tamil Nadu, 628003

items.information:
* Kindly bring your ID card while entering the campus.
* If you're participating in a WCA competition for first time or unaware of competition rules, make sure that you attend the tutorial session.
* Participants must bring their own cubes. 
* Kindly make your own arrangements for your food.
